description:
Edit a memory. Provide only what changes; omitted fields untouched.

Modes:
1. Content replace (content [+topics/macro_topics]): full rewrite, re-embeds. Do it the instant the user corrects a memory ("actually...").
2. Metadata patch (topics/type/expiry, no content): type/expiry alone do not re-embed, a topics or macro_topics change always does (in every mode -- the topic prefix is stored as part of the passage). To add or drop one tag use add_topics/remove_topics (add_macro_topics/remove_macro_topics); topics/macro_topics replace the whole list.
3. Task surgery: toggle=[0,2] flips checkboxes; set_status pending/active/blocked/review/done ("done" -> task_done); set_summary replaces "## Summary"; add_steps/remove_steps/edit_step. Step-op indices are pre-call state.
4. Output capture (output): attach a durable finding. Atomic, front-loaded, same quality as memory_add.
   GOOD "OAuth2 callback uses PKCE S256 -- prevents code interception without client secret"
   BAD  "looked at the code, found interesting auth stuff"
   Over-length is rejected, not truncated. Many findings -> memory_add directly.

Combine rules:
  content     combines ONLY with set_status (its sole partner)
  toggle      + set_status + set_summary + step-ops
  set_status  + toggle + set_summary + step-ops + content
  set_summary + toggle + set_status + step-ops
  step-ops    + toggle + set_status + set_summary
  output      attaches to any toggle/set_status update

add_macro_topics.description: macro_topics to add; the rest stay.

add_topics.description: Topics to add; the rest stay.

artifact.description: Commit SHA or filename -> merged into topics. e.g. "f4e5d6c".

collection.description: Collection for signal routing (only with signal param).

content.description: New memory text — plain prose only, never a serialized object (re-embeds). topics, macro_topics and type are separate parameters; put them there, never inside this text.

edit_step.description: Rewrite a step's text, preserving checkbox state. Re-embeds.

output.description: Durable finding on this update -> linked fact memory (inherits task topics). Atomic, front-loaded. Over-length rejected. Many findings -> memory_add.

ref.description: Parent task/ticket id -> merged into topics. e.g. "a1b2c3d4".

remove_macro_topics.description: macro_topics to drop; the rest stay.

remove_steps.description: Remove steps by 0-based index (pre-call state). Re-embeds.

remove_topics.description: Topics to drop; the rest stay. At least one must remain.

set_status.description: Task status. "done" auto-sets type=task_done (reverting reverts); type follows status. See Combine rules.

set_summary.description: Replace the task's "## Summary" block ("" clears). Re-embeds. Not type="summary" (that is memory_consolidate).

signal.description: Also signal recipient (email, agent, "owner") with this memory_id. Needs a SHARED collection ("me"/personal rejected).

toggle.description: 0-based checkbox indices to flip. e.g. [0,2]. See Combine rules.

topics.description: New topics (REPLACES all). Search words, lowercase.

name: memory_edit
